hero.intro: Facilitated peer circles for women employees. Guided breathing, structured sharing and clear confidentiality rules give people a safe room to talk about pressure at work and at home.

shift.heading: For women who need a grounded space to share, release and rise.
shift.body:
This circle is designed to support emotional honesty, confidence and workplace belonging. The tone is warm,
          contained and practical, with facilitation that respects privacy and group comfort.

rhythm.heading: Safety first, then sharing.
rhythm.body:
The circle is designed to feel held and respectful. It moves slowly from trust-building into guided expression,
          then closes with confidence and personal intention.

steps.title: Ground
steps.description: Simple rituals and listening agreements create a calm, private container for the group.

steps.title: Share
steps.description: Facilitated prompts and somatic exercises support release without pressure to perform.

steps.title: Rise
steps.description: Confidence practices and intentions turn the circle into grounded workplace support.

items.question: Who is this for?
items.answer: Women's networks, ERGs and teams — from ICs to leadership. Built around trust and honest sharing.

items.question: Is sharing mandatory?
items.answer: Never. The circle invites sharing but listening is always enough. No one is put on the spot.

items.question: How many can join a circle?
items.answer: 6–25. Smaller keeps it intimate and safe; we split larger groups into circles.

items.question: Is confidentiality protected?
items.answer: Yes — we open every circle with a confidentiality agreement so people feel safe to be honest.

items.question: On-site or studio?
items.answer: Either — a private room at your office or a calm studio in Gurgaon/NCR.

items.question: Can we run this for Women's Day?
items.answer: Yes, it's a popular Women's Day and IWD-week booking. Reserve early — those dates fill fast.

items.question: What does it cost?
items.answer: Quoted per circle, scaled to size and duration. Book a call for a number.

items.question: How much notice do you need?
items.answer: 5–7 days typically; more for Women's Day week.
